question: If Glacier Logistics experiences a temporary internet outage, which of the following best describes the user experience for those working in the warehouse with a local Azure File Sync server?

options.text: Users cannot access any files until the connection is restored.
Users can continue to access all files that are currently cached (tiered-in) on the local server.
The local server immediately deletes all tiered files to prevent corruption.
All files turn into read-only mode until the connection is restored.

explanation:
Because Azure File Sync keeps a local copy of frequently accessed files, those files remain available during a network outage. Only files that exist *only* in the cloud (tiered-out) will be inaccessible until the connection is restored.

**Why not the other options:**
- **Cannot access any** — Incorrect, cached data is still available locally.
- **Deletes files / Read-only** — These are not the standard behaviors of the File Sync agent during disconnects.
